meta.message: A 96x96, 9-frame one-shot critical hit: a white-hot four-point star flashes on the impact, a ring snaps out, and orange-red streaks and dark red blood chunks fly outward and fall away, with no ground circle, side-on. Try the crit colour slider for a harsher or cooler core, and the blood colour and amount sliders to make the spray heavier or lighter.
